target_customer: Consumers organizing parties and group events
problem: Evite-style invitations were cluttered and slow to set up and RSVP.
business_model: Free consumer site, ads or ticketing add-ons (not confirmed)

founders.name: Jeff Morin
previous_startups: Coordinatr (earlier invitation site, relaunched as Anyvite)
founders.background_notes: Named as president in TechCrunch July 2008; YC page lists him as founder.

founders.name: Dan Morin
previous_startups: Coordinatr (earlier invitation site, relaunched as Anyvite)
founders.background_notes: Listed on the YC page only.

technical_complexity.rationale: Standard web app with email RSVP flow; the team had already built a prototype called Coordinatr.

defensibility.rationale: Several similar invitation services existed and the product was a simpler variant, so it was easy to copy.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Evite kept its lead and later bought Fete (2017); no evidence it acted against Anyvite.

market_need_then: Evite was widely used but criticized in launch coverage as cluttered, and several rivals chased the same simplicity gap.

rebrands.why: TechCrunch says the team relaunched the earlier site under a new name after joining YC; no further reason given.

brand_strength.rationale: Branding search found no press, brand pages or community evidence for this brand, so it is rated as the lowest tier by default, not as a judged weakness.

outcome_analysis: Anyvite relaunched Coordinatr as a simpler Evite alternative at YC S08 and raised only the YC seed according to a single database. It faced a leader and several rivals with a copyable product and no clear revenue model, and no later rounds or press were found. A TrustRadius listing suggests it was operated by Simpletastic Inc. for a time, but the cause and date of the YC inactive status are not public.
notes: Company site returned HTTP 503 when fetched. Seed of $20K rests on a single database (CB Insights); Seedtable gives 1 Jun 2008 with no amount. Failure factors are inferred from the competitive set; the shutdown cause is not public, so they are low certainty. Exit unknown: YC says Inactive, no shutdown notice found. TechCrunch Sept 2009 still calls it a YC funded Evite competitor.
